claims.summary: Twist open band: over any field, for the product pigeonhole system with Boolean axioms at its top degree n (J its degree-n closure) and a twisted repair (lem:twist-window-trade's definition, rho(x_i)=x_i I for untwisted variables) at window W whose twisted variables are t hole variables on distinct pigeons and distinct holes: (a) at W = n with n >= 2 and m >= 2 it is scalar on nu (lem:top-window-twist-scalar); (b) if TW + tT + deg nu <= n, some coordinate of some u_sigma is a substitution repair at window W in J with multiplier degree <= deg nu + tT (lem:twist-window-trade (a) with room n; holds for any twisted Boolean variables on any system with D' for n); (c) with m, n >= 2, a twisted repair outside the scalar and substitution classes needs W <= n-1 and TW + tT + deg nu >= n+1; at T = 1 this includes one twist at tight room (W + deg nu = n, deg nu >= 1). A combination of the two recorded lemmas.
claims.assessment: Working proof, a combination of two recorded lemmas, passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (a false count of twists withdrawn, m >= 2 added to (c)).
claims.rationale: Confines the matrix item's question on the product pigeonhole system to one band.
